# dmh.dev — Dennis Martin Herbers

> Personal website, software engineering portfolio, standalone mini-apps hub, and technical blog of Dennis Martin Herbers.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://www.dmh.dev/): Overview of dmh.dev, engineering focus, and featured sections.
- [Projects & Mini-Apps](https://www.dmh.dev/projects): Showcase of software projects and standalone mini-apps hosted on `*.dmh.dev` subdomains.
- [Blog](https://www.dmh.dev/blog): Articles and notes on software architecture, Angular, modern web development, and side projects.
- [About](https://www.dmh.dev/about): Background on Dennis Martin Herbers, work, and engineering interests.
